## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] Title/commits use factual Conventional Commits, without AI, prompt or user-request attribution.
- [ ] The change is focused; obsolete code is not retained solely as commented-out history.
- [ ] Existing license and copyright notices are preserved.
- [ ] No secrets, working connection/subscription links, QR codes or real IPs appear in the diff or attachments.
- [ ] I recorded verification honestly, including checks not run and the reasons.
- [ ] Affected compatibility/security boundaries and documentation are updated, or not applicable.
- [ ] User-facing changes cover RU/EN/FR and relevant accessibility/motion behavior, or not applicable.
- [ ] Machine-checked server-script parity markers/contracts remain intact, or not applicable.
- [ ] Version/build changes are coordinated with the release owner rather than bumped per contribution.
